name: TDXRay
impact: Untrusted host reconstructs 64-byte cache-line access traces of an unmodified Intel TDX VM, recovering secrets such as LLM prompts from tokenizer access patterns
mitigation: No patch: eliminating the leakage requires design changes to the underlying hardware
boundary_statement: TDXRay (IEEE S&P 2026) recovers 64-byte cache-line traces from unmodified Intel TDX VMs and reconstructs user prompts from LLM tokenizer access patterns (Llama 3.2 91.5%, Gemma 3 94.2% similarity). The paper states that eliminating the leakage necessitates design changes to the underlying hardware, so no software mitigation is claimed.

Intel-TDX.evidence: Project site / IEEE S&P 2026 paper: cache-line-granularity tracing of unmodified Intel TDX VMs; recovering LLM prompts is enabled by the hardware design, and eliminating it requires hardware design changes.
